scope: Within a PaperAccountPortfolio, strategy books now require distinct durable journals, OMS objects, ledger objects and position maps. Repository-wide and cross-runner ownership remains outside this composition root.
remaining_blocker: The runtime guard covers only accounts registered in one PaperAccountPortfolio; it does not prevent legacy and forward runner composition roots from owning competing order, ledger or position state for the same logical book.
limitations: No repository-wide registry coordinates ownership across legacy and newer engines.
The inventory numbers measure coverage gaps, not completeness of system ownership.
Callers must construct all books that share a portfolio through this guarded composition root.
